name: Aioi (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Aioi city emblem in white: a stylised brush-stroke character with a splash.
history: Municipal flag of Aioi, a city in Hyōgo Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 October 1992; the emblem dates from 12 December 1942.

features.role: Aioi city emblem — a stylised brush-stroke character with a splash
